guide: Four Claude Code skills, each a reusable slash command, can run a content pipeline: script, reel edit, carousel and motion video. You need a Claude plan that includes Claude Code, a cloud folder such as Google Drive for the output, and ffmpeg installed.
1. Install Claude Code and create a skills folder, with one skill per job: script, video edit, carousel and motion reel.
1. Write the script skill in Claude Code so it reads your past scripts or transcripts and drafts the next one in your voice.
1. Write the video edit skill so it uses ffmpeg to pick the cleanest take of each line and cut the dead air from your raw clips.
1. Write the carousel skill so it builds slides as HTML and exports each one as an image sized for Instagram and TikTok.
1. Write the motion reel skill so it draws each scene in code and renders a video with ffmpeg, with no camera needed.
1. Point all four skills at one Google Drive folder so every script, reel and carousel lands in the same place.
1. Run each skill by typing its slash command in Claude Code, then review the output before you post it.
Watch out: the skills are only text files and cost nothing, but Claude Code needs a paid Claude plan to run them.

```
You are helping me build a set of four Claude Code skills that run my content pipeline. I use Claude Code on a paid Claude plan, ffmpeg, and Google Drive. My niche is <my niche> and my voice is <describe my tone>.
Create four skills, each as its own SKILL.md file that I can call with a slash command:
1. script: reads my past scripts or transcripts in <folder> and writes the next script in my voice about <topic>.
2. video edit: takes raw clips from <folder>, uses ffmpeg to choose the cleanest take of each line and remove dead air, and outputs one reel.
3. carousel: builds slides as HTML and exports each as an image for Instagram (4:5) and TikTok (9:16).
4. motion reel: draws each scene in code and renders a video with ffmpeg, with no camera.
All outputs should save to <Google Drive folder>. Keep each skill short and give it clear inputs and outputs. Do not post anything automatically; I review everything first. Return the folder layout, the full text of each SKILL.md, and the commands I need to install ffmpeg and test each skill once.
```
